scope: Pure private drawing and recovery primitives. Browser integration and its integration tests are a separate dependent change. No hosted, provider, physical-device or separate-network acceptance.
behavior: Absolute stroke offsets deduplicate repeated or overlapping matching ranges, stage bounded gaps without displaying holes, reject conflicting style/points atomically, and preserve legacy append messages. Complete snapshot strokes retain up to 3200 points.

Fresh snapshot proofs bind the recipient, fresh request nonce, batch, part count/index, sequence and SHA-256 digest of the complete bounded payload; staging completes atomically. Embedded signed body key order is preserved.
Peer assembly has a distinct untrusted brand and cannot supply a fresh host proof. Signature checks, socket ownership and authority decisions remain the browser integration responsibility.

A bounded recovery journal merges continuous offset drawing and already verified persistent controls onto a complete snapshot without erasing live chat, lowering the global replay floor, reviving an old clear epoch or importing unknown older controls.

An explicit preserveDrawing option retains the reconnecting creator’s same-epoch canvas when an uninitialized peer answers first; a higher verified clear still discards older drawing. Conflicts, missing ranges and capacity limits fail atomically.
